name: The Shops At Westover Hills
summary: The Shops at Westover Hills is a neighborhood shopping center strategically located on Texas Highway 151 in northwest San Antonio. Serving the affluent Westover Hills community and surrounding areas, the center offers a convenient mix of retail, dining, and service tenants for daily shopping needs.
demographics: The Shops at Westover Hills serves an affluent suburban San Antonio market in the rapidly growing northwest corridor. The primary trade area attracts middle to upper-middle income families and professionals, with household incomes typically ranging from $75,000 to $150,000+. The center draws visitors from nearby master-planned communities who seek convenient neighborhood shopping with a mix of specialty retail, services, and dining options. The demographic profile skews toward families with children, young professionals, and empty nesters who value quality and convenience in their shopping experience.
description: The Shops at Westover Hills is a neighborhood shopping destination located along Texas Highway 151 in the thriving Westover Hills area of San Antonio. This well-positioned retail center serves the growing northwest San Antonio market, offering convenient access to residents of nearby master-planned communities and the broader metropolitan area. The center provides a curated mix of retail, dining, and service tenants that cater to the daily needs and lifestyle preferences of the surrounding affluent suburban population. With its strategic location along a major thoroughfare and ample parking, The Shops at Westover Hills has established itself as a go-to destination for neighborhood shopping and services. The center's tenant mix reflects the quality-conscious preferences of its trade area, combining national retailers with local businesses to create a shopping experience that balances convenience with community character.
